skeleton: friendly duck-billed Parasaurolophus standing upright on its two back legs, three-quarter view turned to the left, its long neck rising to a head with a long curved tube crest: root at the feet; body (pivot at the hips) with belly squash, the body piece carrying the long neck up under the head (its top a soft unoutlined edge) and its striped back running into the root of the tail, ending in a soft unoutlined cut the tail tucks under; head (with its crest, no neck) on top of the neck, face with eyes (the far one smaller, by the bill), brows and the bill's mouth; armL (far little arm, behind the chest, shaded) and armR (near little arm, in front of the chest) at the shoulders; legL (far leg, behind the tummy, shaded) and legR (near leg, its big round thigh in front of the body, top faded in) at the hips, each whole from the thigh to the foot; tail behind the body, its bone at the join; a fern sprig prop at the bill for munching.

sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a friendly yellow-and-coral Parasaurolophus, a duck-billed dinosaur standing on its two back legs, turned a little to the left, with a long neck and a long curved coral tube crest sweeping back from its head. Draw this exact Parasaurolophus as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body with its long neck: the yellow body with its cream tummy and cream throat and the soft coral stripes on its back, turned as in image 1, without head, without arms, without legs and without tail: no arms, hands, legs or feet drawn on it, the tummy one smooth round shape. At the top, the cream throat and the yellow back of the long neck go up as in image 1, as wide as the neck is just under the head, and end in a soft, smooth edge with NO outline (it is hidden under the head). At the back, the striped back runs on smoothly into the very root of the tail and ends there in a soft edge cut straight down, with NO outline across it (the tail tucks under it): no round bump, no stump, no line where the tail would join. The drawing's dark outline runs only along the front of the neck and chest, round the tummy and along the back.
2. the head alone with its crest, without neck: the head with its rounded yellow duck bill, its little nostril, the rosy cheek, the soft coral stripes and the long curved coral tube crest with its darker spots sweeping back from the top of the head to its rounded end, turned as in image 1, the crest drawn whole. A completely blank face: no eyes, no eyebrows, no mouth and no mouth line, the bill and the cream jaw one smooth closed shape; keep the nostril, the rosy cheek and the little bump of the head's outline where the far eye sits by the bill. Keep its dark outline round the crest, over the top of the head, round the bill and along the jaw under the bill to the chin, as in image 1. From the chin round to the back of the neck its bottom edge is soft, with NO outline: the cream throat and the yellow back of the neck simply stop there, a little below the rosy cheek.
3. the far little arm: the little arm on the left of image 1, behind the chest, drawn whole from the top of its shoulder (normally hidden behind the chest) down to its little hand with soft, round, blunt brown fingertips, hanging as in image 1; its top a full, smooth, rounded end with no outline across it.
4. the near little arm: the little arm on the right of image 1, held in front of the chest, drawn whole from the top of its shoulder (normally hidden in the chest) down to its little hand with soft, round, blunt brown fingertips, hanging as in image 1; its top a full, smooth, rounded end with no outline across it.
5. the far leg: the leg on the left of image 1, drawn whole from the top of its thigh (normally hidden behind the round tummy) down to its foot with three soft, round, blunt brown toenails, as in image 1; its top a full, smooth, rounded end with no outline across it.
6. the near leg: the big leg on the right of image 1, drawn whole from the top of its big round thigh down to its foot with three soft, round, blunt brown toenails, as in image 1, the round thigh with its whole outline as in image 1.
7. the tail: the long tapering tail with its coral stripes on top and its cream underside, as in image 1, drawn whole from its thick root (normally hidden inside the body) to its tip; its root a soft, smooth edge cut straight across with NO outline.
8. a small sprig of fresh green fern leaves with a short stalk, about as long as the Parasaurolophus's bill, in the same drawing style.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. Nothing sharp: no teeth, no pointed claws. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a friendly yellow-and-coral duck-billed Parasaurolophus; image 2 shows the same Parasaurolophus cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the Parasaurolophus's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the Parasaurolophus in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2. Its head is turned to the left: its far eye (on the left of image 1, just above the bill, on the head's outline) is much smaller and narrower than its near eye (on the right of image 1). In image 1 both eyes look to the left: each dark-brown iris with its white sparkle sits towards the left of its eye, the white on its right, outlined in dark brown.

Draw each piece on its own, upright, in four tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
Row 1, the far eye (the small narrow eye, on the LEFT of image 1), six times:
1. as it is in image 1: a small tall oval eye, its big dark-brown iris with a white sparkle towards the left, a little white on its right, outlined in dark brown.
2. wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, a warm-brown iris with a dark pupil and a white sparkle, looking the same way.
3. closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc, like an upside-down U, with two little lashes.
4. sad: open and round, a soft warm-brown iris with a white sparkle and a thin shine of a welling tear along its bottom rim, looking down and to the left; no lid slanting across it.
5. crying: squeezed shut, a thick lid line as wide as the open eye, curving down at both ends like a little frown, and one small light-blue teardrop just below its outer (left) end.
6. gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line as wide as the open eye, with a few short lashes.
Row 2, the near eye (the bigger eye, on the RIGHT of image 1), the same six in the same order; open, it looks the same way as row 1, to the left, the iris towards the left of the eye; crying, its teardrop below its outer (right) end.
Row 3: 13. the far eyebrow (over the left eye of image 1) as it is in image 1, a short thin dark-brown arch. 14. the same far eyebrow worried: tilted up at its inner (right) end. 15. the near eyebrow (over the right eye of image 1) as it is in image 1, a thin dark-brown arch. 16. the same near eyebrow worried: tilted up at its inner (left) end.
Row 4, mouths of the duck bill, none with any teeth: 17. the mouth as it is in image 1: a long, thin, closed smiling line running back from the tip of the bill, gently curved, curling up into a little smile at its right end. 18. the bill open wide in a big happy laugh, the upper bill lifted, the inside pink with a little pink tongue, no teeth. 19. the bill open in a small round 'o', the inside pink. 20. the bill in a small sad frown, a closed line curving down. 21. the bill wide open in a big round honking call, as for a loud happy honk or a big yawn, rounded, the inside pink with a little tongue, no teeth. 22. the bill closed and munching: a short wavy closed line with the cheek puffed round, chewing. 23. the bill sobbing: a small open downturned frown with a little pink inside.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

animations.description: the Parasaurolophus walks along on its two back legs, its long tail swaying behind it, then stops.
the Parasaurolophus crouches, jumps up for joy with its little arms up and lands with a little squash.
the Parasaurolophus laughs and laughs, its round tummy bouncing with giggles.
the Parasaurolophus does a happy little dance, swaying from side to side and swinging its long tail.
the Parasaurolophus cries, head down, little tears falling, its tummy shaking with sobs.
the Parasaurolophus gives a big yawn, closes its eyes and falls asleep standing up, then wakes up, blinks and smiles.

pause.shows: the Parasaurolophus fast asleep standing up, eyes shut, head drooped

animations.description: the Parasaurolophus waves hello with one little hand.
the Parasaurolophus takes a big breath, lifts its head and honks a big, happy call through its long crest, then smiles, pleased.

pause.shows: the Parasaurolophus honking a big happy call, head lifted, bill open wide

animations.description: the Parasaurolophus honks a little tune through its crest, swaying gently from side to side.

pause.shows: the Parasaurolophus singing, head lifted, bill open in a happy honk

animations.description: the Parasaurolophus nibbles a sprig of fern leaves, munching and munching until it is all gone, then smiles.
the Parasaurolophus lowers its bill and sniffs, sniff, sniff, then lifts its head with a happy smile.
the Parasaurolophus stretches up tall with its little arms up and its tail out long, gives a big yawn, then settles with a happy sigh.

animations.description: the Parasaurolophus swishes its long tail happily from side to side.
